name: scopelock
description: ScopeLock — shared system of record for client scope, change requests, approvals, and delivery evidence.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build:packages && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w packages/contracts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/domain && npm run typecheck -w packages/contracts && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/domain && npm run test -w apps/api
